Criteria for Approval:
• Prescribed by, or in consultation with, a hematologist or liver disease specialist; AND
• Diagnosis of one of the following conditions:
○ Chronic immune (idiopathic) thrombocytopenic purpura (ITP); OR
○ Treatment of thrombocytopenia in patients with chronic hepatitis C (to allow the initiation & maintenance of interferon-based therapy); OR
○ Treatment of severe aplastic anemia in patients who have had an insufficient response to immunosuppressive therapy.

Renewal Criteria:
• Documentation (e.g., progress note, laboratory report) of response to therapy.

Quantity Limit:
• 12.5 mg, 25 mg: 3 per day
• 50 mg, 75 mg: 2 per day
